## About
Treasure Tires & Auto LLC is a tire shop on Austell Rd in Marietta. We sell new and used tires, fix flats, do wheel alignments and take care of auto repair, including heavy-duty work.
Our used tires are graded before they go out, so you can save money without giving up on safety. If your car is pulling or your tires are wearing unevenly, we can check the alignment and show you what we find.
Drivers have given us a 4.7 rating from 313 Google reviews. We work by appointment, so call ahead and we will find you a time.

## Services
- Wheel alignment: We check how far out of alignment your vehicle is and set it back where it should be.
- New tires: Safe tires at competitive prices, fitted for the road ahead.
- Used tires: Graded used tires that cost less than new and are checked for safety before they are sold.
- Tire repair: Leaks, punctures and other tire trouble, looked at and repaired so you can get back on the road.
- Auto repair: General auto repair and heavy-duty repairs, along with tire work and alignments.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes. We work by appointment, so please call before you come in.

Q: Does the price change for my type of vehicle?
A: It can. Some vehicles and services take more time, labor or special equipment, including Jeeps, European vehicles, SUVs, vans, minivans and pickup trucks. Call us to find out about any extra charges.
